items.title_zh: Cloudflare 推出新开源库，为每个 AI 智能体配备独立工作计算机
items.title_en: Cloudflare Unveils Open-Source Library for AI Agents' Dedicated Virtual Work Computers
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 4 日消息，Cloudflare 昨日（8 月 3 日）发布博文，宣布以早期预览版形式，推出 @cloudflare/computer 开源库， 为每个 AI 智能体独立分配虚拟工作计算机，并包含文件系统与命令执行能力。 官方指出有别于传统文本方式的聊天 AI，编程类 AI 智能体需要反复读取源代码、改写文件、运行测试、审查结果并继续修正，因此需要保存处理中文件的工作区，也需要运行程序的环境。 目前行业主流方案是为 AI 智能体构建容器，容器可提供隔离的 Linux 环境和各类工具，但若持续为每名用户的 AI 智能体分配专属容器，将消耗大量 CPU 与内存。尤其当系统需同时运行数亿至数十亿个 AI 智能体时，为每个智能体配置容器的模式面临扩展性限制。 Cloudflare 此前为平衡算力和成本，在 Cloudflare Workers 中引入可快速启动的轻量执行环境 Isolate，轻量任务由 Isolate 处理，重负载任务才调用容器。 而最新 @cloudflare/computer 开源库以 Isolate 为基础，围绕着工作区（workspace）构建，使用 SQLite 支持虚拟文件系统，可从云存储、Git 仓库或自定义文件导入内容。 IT之家援引博文介绍，工作区提供 read、write、edit、ls 和 exec 等 AI SDK 兼容工具；所有操…
items.summary_en: Cloudflare has released an early preview of the @cloudflare/computer open-source library, which assigns each AI agent a dedicated virtual work computer with file system and command execution. Built on the lightweight Isolate environment with SQLite-based virtual file system, it offers AI SDK-compatible tools like read, write, edit, ls, and exec, addressing scalability issues of container-based approaches for billions of agents.
items.why_zh: 这一方案有望大幅降低AI智能体大规模并行运行的基础设施成本，推动Agent应用规模化落地。
items.why_en: This approach could drastically cut infrastructure costs for running billions of AI agents, accelerating large-scale agent deployments.

items.title_zh: 荷兰合作银行拟投资20亿欧元发展AI和技术，净利润停滞
items.title_en: Rabobank to spend €2 billion in AI and tech as net profit stagnates
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，荷兰合作银行（Rabobank）计划在人工智能和技术领域投资20亿欧元，但与此同时其净利润停滞不前。这一投资显示该行正试图通过科技升级应对增长压力，但投资的具体领域、时间表以及对财务的预期影响尚未公布。
items.summary_en: Rabobank to spend €2 billion in AI and tech as net profit stagnates Reuters
items.why_zh: 在利润增长乏力之际大举投入AI与技术，凸显传统银行向科技驱动转型的紧迫性和战略决心。
items.why_en: Investing heavily in AI and tech amid stagnant profits underscores the urgency for traditional banks to transform into tech-driven institutions.

items.title_zh: 蚂蚁阿福否认“1 号位伟鹤调整”传闻：假消息
items.title_en: Ant Afu Denies Rumors of 'No. 1 Position Change for Wei He' as False News
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 4 日消息，蚂蚁阿福官方微博今日发文辟谣， 网传“蚂蚁阿福 1 号位伟鹤调整”为假消息 。 据IT之家此前报道，去年 12 月， 蚂蚁集团旗下 AI 健康应用 AQ 品牌升级为蚂蚁阿福 ，并发布 App 新版本，升级健康陪伴、健康问答、健康服务三大功能。该应用和 8 省市卫健委、18 省市医保局“依保儿”合作，推出 200 家医院就医智能体，并与 16 家机构 AI 联合研究。 今年 2 月，蚂蚁阿福官方发文宣布，这个春节假期， 蚂蚁阿福 App 的用户数超 1 亿 。
items.summary_en: Ant Afu's official Weibo account denied the rumor of a leadership change for 'Wei He,' calling it false news. Ant Afu is Ant Group's AI health app, rebranded from AQ last December, with over 100 million users as of February. The denial aims to quell speculation about personnel reshuffles.
items.why_zh: 官方第一时间辟谣有助于稳定用户与市场信心，避免不实人事传闻影响品牌信誉。
items.why_en: Immediate denial helps stabilize user and market confidence, preventing reputational damage from unfounded personnel rumors.

items.title_zh: AIJRF 推出先进 Agentic AI 媒体项目
items.title_en: AIJRF Launches advanced Agentic AI Media Program
items.summary_zh: AIJRF 近日宣布启动一项名为“Agentic AI Media Program”的先进项目。该消息目前仅以简讯形式发布，未披露项目的具体内容、目标或时间表。从名称来看，该项目旨在结合自主智能体（Agentic AI）技术与媒体传播场景，探索 AI 在内容生产与分发中的新应用。这是 AIJRF 在智能体 AI 与媒体融合领域的最新动作，可能对媒体行业的工作流程产生潜在影响。由于公开信息有限，后续细节值得持续关注。
items.summary_en: AIJRF Launches advanced Agentic AI Media Program intlbm
items.why_zh: 这是智能体 AI 与媒体行业跨界结合的最新动向，但具体影响仍需更多信息披露。
items.why_en: It marks a notable cross-sector move toward agentic AI in media, though details remain to be seen.

items.title_zh: 北京一酒吧上线“不限量免费 Token”服务，到店连接 Wi-Fi 即可畅用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 模型
items.title_en: Beijing Bar Offers Unlimited Free Tokens: Use DeepSeek V4 Flash via Wi-Fi
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 4 日消息，北京一家主打程序员交流的酒吧 AGI Bar 宣布推出一项“Token 免费畅饮”服务，顾客到店消费并连接店内 Wi-Fi 后，即可获得 DeepSeek V4 Flash API 免费使用权限。 据 AGI Bar 公布的信息， 其采购了英伟达 DGX Spark AI 工作站以提供 DeepSeek V4 Flash 算力服务，一切 Token 均由本地推理 。顾客只需获取店家提供的 Base URL 和 API Key，即可在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cherry Studio 等支持 OpenAI API 格式的开发工具中直接调用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 模型。 公开信息显示，AGI Bar 由长期参与 AI 创业领域的人士创立，目前在北京和上海各开了一家店铺。Midjourney 创始人 David Holz 此前访问中国内地期间，也曾到访 AGI Bar 与开发者进行交流。 此次 AGI Bar 提供免费 AI API 服务，也体现出 AI 应用正在从传统线上软件工具逐渐延伸至现实消费场景。虽然目前仍属于单一商业空间的探索尝试，但随着大模型推理成本持续下降，未来可能会有更多咖啡酒吧、共享办公室将 AI 算力作为探索新方向。
items.summary_en: A Beijing bar for programmers, AGI Bar, now offers free DeepSeek V4 Flash API access to customers who connect to its Wi-Fi. The service is powered by an NVIDIA DGX Spark workstation running local inference, and users can call the model via OpenAI-compatible tools. It's a creative example of blending AI services with offline consumer spaces.
items.why_zh: 该案例展示了大模型服务与线下实体场景结合的新模式，可能为商业引流和 AI 普及提供新思路。
items.why_en: This is a creative example of integrating LLM services into offline businesses, offering a new model for customer engagement.

items.title_zh: 城堡证券预计AI热潮下的芯片需求将掀起5000亿美元债务融资热潮
items.title_en: Citadel Securities Forecasts $500B Debt Financing Wave Driven by AI Chip Demand
items.summary_zh: 信贷市场对数据中心创纪录的融资活动可能已感到厌倦，但科技公司尚未停下脚步。城堡证券预测，截止到2028年，它们还将在公开市场和私募市场进行超过5000亿美元的债务融资，为人工智能（AI）园区建设所需芯片提供资金。该公司投资级债券部门首席分析师Jeff Eason表示，这一金额相当于彭博美国投资级债券指数总规模的5%以上。他预计，大部分所发债券的期限将较短，约三至五年，匹配芯片的使用寿命，其中一部分可能会以144A私募形式发行。（新浪财经）
items.summary_en: Citadel Securities expects tech companies to raise over $500 billion in debt financing by 2028 to fund AI chips, equivalent to more than 5% of the Bloomberg U.S. Investment Grade Bond Index. Most bonds are likely to have 3-5 year maturities to match chip lifespans, with some sold via 144A private placements. The forecast underscores AI's growing impact on debt markets.
items.why_zh: 该预测揭示了 AI 算力扩张将对债务融资市场产生数千亿美元的增量冲击。
items.why_en: The forecast highlights the massive capital demands of AI infrastructure and their potential to reshape debt markets.

items.title_zh: 丰田汽车 2027 财年第一财季归母净利润 1.48 万亿日元，同比增长 75.56%
items.title_en: Toyota Q1 FY2027 Net Profit Soars 75.56% to ¥1.48 Trillion
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 4 日消息，丰田汽车今日发布 2027 财年（2026 年 4 月 1 日～2027 年 3 月 31 日）第一财季（2026 年 4 月 1 日～2026 年 6 月 30 日）业绩快报报告： 营业总收入 ： 13.53 万亿日元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,819.79 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 10.38% 毛利润 ： 1.06 万亿日元 （现汇率约合 455.95 亿元人民币） ，同比下降 8.80% 毛利率 ： 7.86%，同比下降 1.66 个百分点 归母净利润 ： 1.48 万亿日元 （现汇率约合 636.61 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 75.56% 经营现金流 ： 5,365.51 亿日元 （现汇率约合 230.79 亿元人民币） ，同比下降 71.41% 基本每股收益 ： 120.69 日元 （现汇率约合 5.2 元人民币） ，同比增长 86.94% 稀释每股收益 ： 120.69 日元 （现汇率约合 5.2 元人民币） ，同比增长 86.94% 资产负债率 ： 62.75% AI 解读 本次财报丰田汽车 2027 财年第一财季核心业绩大幅超市场普遍预期，营收和归母净利润均实现双位数同比增长。 财报核心亮点 营业收入达到 13.53 万亿日元 （现汇率约合 5,819.79 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 10.38% ；归属于母公司股东的净利润达到…
items.summary_en: Toyota's first-quarter net profit surged 75.56% YoY to ¥1.48 trillion, beating expectations, with revenue up 10.38% to ¥13.53 trillion. However, gross profit fell 8.80% to ¥1.06 trillion and operating cash flow dropped 71.41% to ¥536.55 billion. The mix suggests strong profit growth but weakening margins and cash generation.
items.why_zh: 丰田单季净利润大增但毛利率与现金流下滑，反映汽车行业利润与成本压力并存的复杂局面。
items.why_en: Toyota's profit surge contrasts with falling margins and cash flow, revealing operational challenges beneath the strong bottom line.

items.title_zh: IDC：2025 年中国外骨骼机器人市场规模超过 16 亿元，出货量约 2.6 万台
items.title_en: IDC: China's Exoskeleton Robot Market Exceeds 1.6B Yuan in 2025
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 4 日消息，国际数据公司（IDC）今日首次发布《中国外骨骼机器人市场份额，2025》研究报告， 2025 年中国外骨骼机器人市场规模超过 16 亿元，出货量约 2.6 万台 。 其中， 医疗康复市场仍占据主要市场价值 ，消费助力市场则贡献了七成以上出货量，行业应用持续拓展新的增长空间。三大细分市场共同推动中国外骨骼机器人产业由单一医疗应用向多场景人体能力增强装备加速演进。 报告称，2025 年中国外骨骼机器人市场已形成 医疗康复、消费助力和行业应用 三大市场协同发展的格局，并进入商业化加速成长阶段。 医疗康复外骨骼仍是当前市场规模最大的细分领域，商业模式相对成熟； 消费助力外骨骼受益于人口老龄化、银发经济及产品成本下降，成为增长最快的市场方向； 行业应用（涵盖物流仓储、汽车制造、电力能源、建筑施工、应急救援等多个行业场景）外骨骼则伴随安全生产需求提升和制造业智能化转型，逐步进入规模化应用探索阶段。 2025 年，中国医疗康复外骨骼机器人市场规模约 14.2 亿元，出货规模约 3,200 台。当前，医院康复科、康复专科医院及康复中心仍是主要应用场景。受人口老龄化、康复医疗需求增长、基层康复体系建设及国产替代推动，医疗康复外骨骼成为商业化成熟度最高的细分市场。 傅利叶智能、程天科技、迈步机器人 等厂商在中国医疗康复外骨骼市场占据领先份额。 2025 年，中国消费助力外…
items.summary_en: IDC's inaugural report on China's exoskeleton robot market shows the market surpassed 1.6 billion yuan and shipments reached about 26,000 units in 2025. Medical rehabilitation remains the largest segment by value (1.42 billion yuan), while consumer assistive exoskeletons drive over 70% of shipments. The industry is expanding into logistics, manufacturing, and other sectors, signaling a shift toward multi-scenario human augmentation.
items.why_zh: 这是首份系统梳理中国外骨骼机器人市场结构的数据报告，为理解产业拐点提供了权威参照。
items.why_en: This first IDC report offers authoritative data on the market's size and structure, highlighting its expansion beyond medical use.

items.title_zh: QuestMobile发布AI原生APP用户规模榜：豆包、千问、DeepSeek前三
items.title_en: QuestMobile AI Native App User Scale Ranking: Doubao, Qianwen, DeepSeek Top Three
items.summary_zh: QuestMobile发布AI原生APP用户规模榜：豆包、千问、DeepSeek前三 搜狐网
items.summary_en: QuestMobile released a user scale ranking for AI-native apps, with Doubao, Qianwen and DeepSeek taking the top three spots. The ranking reflects the current competitive landscape of AI-native applications in the domestic market.
items.why_zh: 该榜单直观展示了国内主流 AI 原生应用的用户接受度与市场格局，为行业提供重要参考。
items.why_en: The ranking offers a clear snapshot of user adoption and market positioning among leading AI-native apps in China.

items.title_zh: 本地部署大模型能耗：消费级 GPU 功耗基准的初步研究
items.title_en: Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
items.summary_zh: 该论文针对本地部署大语言模型的能耗问题展开研究，指出现有基准大多只关注准确性，对消费级硬件上的能源成本刻画不足。作者在单块消费级 GPU（RTX 4060Ti 16GB）上，使用 Ollama 推理引擎运行了九个开源大语言模型（参数量 1B 至 7B），并通过 nvidia-smi 以 2Hz 频率对固定提示集采样 GPU 功耗。这种方法提供了一种可复现的硬件级能量基准测试框架。由于所提供摘要信息不完整，具体评估结论尚未完整呈现。这项工作为本地部署大模型的能效评估提供了基础性参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00008v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The local deployment of large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction due to privacy concerns and the desire for on-premise inference. However, the energy costs on consumer hardware remain poorly characterized, as most benchmarks focus solely on accuracy. This paper presents a reproducible, hardware-level energy benchmark of nine open-source LLMs (1B to 7B parameters) executed on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060Ti 16GB). Using the Ollama inference engine, GPU power draw was sampled at 2Hz via nvidia-smi across a fixed prompt set. We evaluate me…
items.why_zh: 随着本地部署大模型需求增长，该论文为消费级硬件上的能效评估提供了可复现方法，填补了领域空白。
items.why_en: As local LLM deployment grows, this benchmark fills a gap by enabling reproducible energy assessment on consumer hardware.

items.title_zh: 歧义去哪儿了？多模态模型如何理解多义词
items.title_en: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
items.summary_zh: 该论文探讨多模态模型如何理解多义词。作者指出，人类语言具有高度多义性，如 bank、palm 等常见词拥有多种含义，大语言模型已被证明能理解这种多义性，但图像等其他模态中的表现尚不清楚。研究对 17 个文生图模型和 15 个文本生成模型进行了测试，在无上下文条件下输入多义词，并通过多次采样统计模型产生的语义。由于所提供的摘要被截断，具体发现尚未完整呈现。该研究有助于揭示模型在不同模态下的语义消歧能力，为多模态理解提供新视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear multi…
items.why_zh: 该研究系统比较了多模态模型在多义词理解上的表现，有助于理解跨模态语义差异。
items.why_en: It systematically compares how multimodal models handle polysemy, offering insights into cross-modal semantic interpretation.

items.title_zh: 贝叶斯反射：用于人工智能的预测编码引擎
items.title_en: The Bayesian Reflex: A Predictive Coding Engine for Artificial Intelligence
items.summary_zh: 预测编码理论为大脑皮层计算提供了有力解释，但一直缺乏可扩展的AI算法实现。研究者提出“贝叶斯反射”（Bayesian Reflex）框架，通过三个支柱直接实现预测编码：基于层级生成模型的信念维护、通过预测误差最小化进行序贯贝叶斯更新，以及借助主动推理实现不确定性驱动的行动。该框架还结合了近期在椭球分解等方面的突破，为构建类脑AI系统提供了新的计算路径。这一思路有望弥合神经科学与机器学习之间的鸿沟。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predictive coding offers a powerful theory of cortical computation, but corresponding scalable algorithmic implementations for artificial intelligence have remained elusive. This paper introduces the Bayesian reflex, a computational framework that directly instantiates predictive coding through three pillars: belief maintenance via hierarchical generative models, sequential Bayesian updating via prediction-error minimization, and uncertainty-driven action via active inference. We show that recent breakthroughs---ellipsoidal decomposition for exac…
items.why_zh: 它为一直难以落地的预测编码理论提供了可扩展的AI计算框架，或将推动类脑智能的新范式。
items.why_en: It offers a scalable computational instantiation of predictive coding, potentially advancing brain-inspired AI.

items.title_zh: FactorJEPA：将整体未来分解为布局-智能体-交互通道，用于拥挤混乱的全球南方城市
items.title_en: FactorJEPA: Factorizing Monolithic Futures into Layout-Agent-Interaction Channels for Crowded and Chaotic Global South Urban Worlds
items.summary_zh: 世界模型旨在捕捉和预测物理世界的结构与动态，联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）是其中颇具前景的方向。现有研究多聚焦于低密度、有明确车道结构的环境，而人口稠密、拥挤混乱的全球南方城市（文中称为DENSEWORLD）尚未被充分探索。这类场景具有软空间边界、极度智能体异质性等特征。FactorJEPA将整体未来预测分解为布局、智能体和交互三个通道，以应对这些复杂城市环境的建模挑战。该工作有望提升世界模型在真实复杂场景中的表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World models have attracted significant attention for their ability to capture and predict the structure and dynamics of the physical world. In this emerging landscape, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer a particularly compelling direction. We study a largely unexplored regime: populous, crowded, and chaotic Global South urban environments, which we call DENSEWORLD. Unlike the lower-density, lane-structured settings that dominate existing evaluations, these scenes exhibit soft spatial boundaries, extreme agent heterogeneity, pe…
items.why_zh: 该研究填补了世界模型在人口密集、混乱的真实城市场景中的空白，推动了更具泛化性的世界模拟。
items.why_en: It fills a gap in world modeling for dense, chaotic real-world urban scenes, promoting more generalizable world simulators.

items.title_zh: CraftAlign：面向AI故事的特征接地评估与修订指导
items.title_en: CraftAlign: Feature-Grounded Evaluation and Revision Guidance for AI Stories
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型虽能生成流畅完整的故事，但输出常因陈词滥调、过度解释、线性因果推进和刻板结局而带有明显的“AI味”。现有检测与评估方法多止步于来源标签或整体评分，修订方法则通常针对预定义问题做局部编辑，难以支持多种合理的修订策略或引导故事层面的信息释放与因果调整。CraftAlign提出基于故事特征的接地评估方法，并为AI故事生成提供具体的修订指导。这有助于提升生成故事的原创性与自然度，减少模式化痕迹。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01377v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models can now generate fluent and complete stories, yet many outputs still feel formulaic and unnatural because of cliches, over-explanation, linear causal progression, and stereotyped endings, an immediately recognizable AI flavor. Existing detection and evaluation methods often stop at source labels or holistic scores, while revision methods typically target predefined issues through localized edits, limiting their ability to support multiple plausible revision strategies or guide story-wide changes in information release, causa…
items.why_zh: 它直击AI故事生成中“公式化”痛点，为评估和修订提供了细粒度、可操作的指导。
items.why_en: It tackles the "AI flavor" in stories by offering fine-grained, actionable evaluation and revision guidance.

items.title_zh: 超越路由饱和：多模态持续指令微调中专家路由的长时程类增量视角
items.title_en: Beyond Routing Saturation: A Long-Horizon Class-Incremental Perspective on Expert Routing in Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
items.summary_zh: 多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）让多模态大模型能够顺序学习新任务而不遗忘旧能力。许多方法为每个任务维护LoRA专家，并在推理时将输入路由到相应专家，但专家路由所依赖的任务识别问题一直未被充分研究。研究显示，在广泛使用的MCIT基准上，路由已接近饱和：文本指纹会泄漏任务身份，且仅包含4-10个任务、竞争专家较少的序列共同掩盖了路由的真实挑战。该工作从长时程类增量视角重新审视路由问题，为更真实的持续学习设置提供新见解。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) enables multimodal large language models to acquire new tasks sequentially while retaining previously learned capabilities. Many recent methods maintain task-specific LoRA experts and route each input to one or more experts at inference. Yet the task-identification problem underlying expert routing remains under-explored. We show that routing is nearly saturated on widely used MCIT benchmarks. Textual fingerprints that leak task identity and short 4--10-task sequences with few competing experts joint…
items.why_zh: 揭示现有MCIT基准中专家路由严重饱和，促使社区面向更真实的长期增量场景设计评测。
items.why_en: It exposes routing saturation in current MCIT benchmarks, urging more realistic long-horizon evaluation.

items.title_zh: GISAgentBench：一个由从业者构建的LLM智能体GIS任务评测基准
items.title_en: GISAgentBench: A Practitioner-Sourced Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on GIS Tasks
items.summary_zh: GIS专业人员常需执行多步空间分析工作流以支持城市规划、灾害响应和环境监测，但这一过程繁琐、耗时且易出错。尽管配备外部工具的LLM智能体有望自动化地理空间分析，其处理真实GIS工作流的能力仍缺乏充分评测。现有GIS智能体基准多来自教科书、教程或LLM生成内容，与现实从业需求存在差距。GISAgentBench从从业者处采集任务，构建了更贴近实际GIS工作的评测基准。该基准可更真实地衡量LLM智能体在空间分析任务中的能力，推动自动化GIS工具发展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geographic Information System (GIS) professionals rely on multi-step spatial analysis workflows to support decision-making in urban planning, disaster response, and environmental monitoring. The process is tedious, time-consuming, and error-prone. While recent large language model (LLM) agents equipped with external tools have the potential to automate geospatial analysis, their ability to perform realistic GIS workflows remains largely unexplored. Existing GIS agent benchmarking datasets are mostly drawn from textbooks, tutorials, or LLM-generat…
items.why_zh: 它为LLM智能体在真实GIS工作流中的能力提供了可信评测，对自动空间分析非常重要。
items.why_en: It provides a credible, practice-grounded benchmark for LLM agents in real GIS workflows, advancing automated geospatial analysis.

items.title_zh: Wnuan：面向企业专有知识问答的分阶段后训练
items.title_en: Wnuan: Staged Post-Training for Question Answering over Proprietary Enterprise Knowledge
items.summary_zh: 企业问答要求模型在获取专有知识的同时不损失通用能力。研究者提出Wnuan三阶段流水线：首先从文档构建任务导向的监督数据，然后结合通用数据重放进行监督微调，最后对残差错误应用强化学习。在包含707个问题的WnuanBench上，主32B路线将可接受答案率（AAR）从适配前的52.76%提升到SFT后的80.06%，并在RL后进一步达到91.51%。这一结果表明，分阶段后训练能显著提升大模型在企业专有知识上的问答表现，同时保持通用能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise question answering requires models to acquire proprietary knowledge without discarding general capabilities. We present Wnuan, a three-stage pipeline that constructs task-oriented supervision from documents, performs supervised fine-tuning with general-data replay, and applies reinforcement learning to residual errors. On the 707-question WnuanBench, the primary 32B route raises acceptable-answer rate (AAR) from 52.76% before adaptation to 80.06% after SFT and 91.51% after RL. Under a matched 100-update protocol, residual-error samplin…
items.why_zh: 为企业知识问答提供了一种兼顾专有知识与通用能力的有效后训练方案，效果显著。
items.why_en: It offers an effective staged post-training approach for enterprise QA, markedly improving answer quality without sacrificing general abilities.

items.title_zh: MonitrLLM：面向社区中心的LLM评估基础设施
items.title_en: MonitrLLM: A Community-Centered Evaluation Infrastructure for Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 现有LLM评估手段各有局限：基准套件仅在受控任务上评测能力，大规模对话语料不包含用户反馈，界面内反馈机制记录满意度却缺乏任务目的，因此缺少一种能将交互轨迹与用户自定义结果关联起来的基础设施。MonitrLLM是一个开源基础设施，面向社区中心的LLM评估，它把完整对话记录与用户报告的任务意图和结果评估相连接。通过这一设计，研究者可以更真实地理解用户目标与模型行为之间的关系。该基础设施有望补充现有评估体系，推动更贴近实际使用的LLM评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.02409v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmark suites assess model capability on controlled tasks; large-scale conversation corpora capture naturalistic use without user feedback; and in-interface feedback mechanisms record satisfaction without task purpose. Together, they leave a critical gap in LLM evaluation: no existing infrastructure routinely links interaction trajectories to user-defined outcomes. We introduce MonitrLLM, open-source infrastructure for community-centered LLM evaluations that links full conversation transcripts to user-reported task intent and outcome assessmen…
items.why_zh: 填补了LLM评估中“交互轨迹与用户定义结果脱节”的关键空白，使评测更贴近真实使用。
items.why_en: It fills a critical gap in LLM evaluation by connecting interaction trajectories to user-defined outcomes, enabling more naturalistic assessment.

items.title_zh: CMuon：通过分块动量正交化加速并稳定扩散Transformer训练
items.title_en: CMuon: Accelerating and Stabilizing Diffusion Transformer Training via Chunked Momentum Orthogonalization
items.summary_zh: 扩散Transformer（DiT）在视觉生成建模上达到先进水平，但训练计算开销极大。近期提出的动量正交化（Muon）优化器被视为AdamW的有力替代，但直接用于DiT时后期收敛表现不佳。研究发现根源在于：标准DiT架构会将功能不同的权重（如AdaLN层和QKV层）融合为统一张量进行计算，阻碍了优化器的有效性。为此，CMuon通过分块动量正交化，将统一张量按功能拆分处理，从而加速并稳定DiT的训练。这一方法有望降低DiT类模型的训练成本，提升生成模型开发效率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.02502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in visual generative modeling, yet their training remains computationally prohibitive. While the recently proposed Momentum Orthogonalization (Muon) optimizer offers a promising alternative to AdamW, its direct application to DiTs yields suboptimal late-stage convergence. In this paper, we identify the root cause of this bottleneck: standard DiT architectures fuse functionally distinct weights (e.g., within AdaLN and QKV layers) into unified tensors for computational…
items.why_zh: 针对DiT训练瓶颈提出高效优化器，可显著降低计算成本，推动扩散模型更广泛的应用。
items.why_en: It addresses a key bottleneck in Diffusion Transformer training, potentially cutting costs and enabling broader adoption.

items.title_zh: EEG-JEPA：用于脑电基础模型的结构化潜在预测
items.title_en: EEG-JEPA: Structured Latent Prediction for EEG Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型旨在从大规模无标注记录中学习可复用的表示。常见的预训练方式是用掩码波形重建，但直接对嘈杂的EEG信号施加监督，容易让模型去重建可预测的背景活动、采集伪影等，而非学到跨任务迁移的神经结构。这引出一个核心问题：EEG基础模型应当预测什么才能学到可迁移的表示？为此，研究者提出EEG-JEPA，采用结构化潜在预测的预训练目标，试图让模型聚焦于真正的神经活动。该工作为EEG基础模型的预训练范式提供了新的思路，有望提升下游任务的表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00114v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models aim to learn reusable representations from large-scale unlabeled recordings. A common pretraining strategy is masked waveform reconstruction, but applying supervision directly to noisy EEG may encourage models to recover predictable background activity, acquisition effects, and artifacts rather than neural structure that transfers across tasks. This raises a central question: what should an EEG foundation model predict to learn transferable representations? We introduce EEG-JEPA a structured latent…
items.why_zh: 该研究挑战了EEG基础模型以波形重建为目标的预训练范式，提出预测结构化潜在表示，有助于提升跨任务迁移能力。
items.why_en: This work challenges the dominant masked reconstruction pretraining for EEG foundation models and proposes structured latent prediction to improve representation transferability.

items.title_zh: 从原子红队技术生成符号攻击链：谓词表示粒度的实证研究
items.title_en: Symbolic Attack Chain Generation from Atomic Red Team Techniques: An Empirical Study of Predicate Representation Granularity
items.summary_zh: 自动攻击链生成对现代网络安全至关重要，但手动构建难以应对日益增长的攻击行为。经典AI规划基于PDDL为自动化提供了形式化方法，但依赖将攻击技术精确翻译为符号谓词。目前最先进的AURORA系统采用九类攻击动作链接模型（AALM），然而这一特定粒度的必要性尚未得到验证。该研究通过实证方法考察谓词表示粒度对攻击链生成的影响，以期为符号化攻击规划中的知识建模提供更可靠的依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00143v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automated attack chain generation is critical for modern cybersecurity, yet manual construction fails to scale as adversary behaviors expand. While classical AI planning using PDDL offers a formal method to automate this process, it relies on the accurate translation of techniques into symbolic predicates. Current state-of-the-art systems like AURORA employ a nine-category Attack Action Linking Model (AALM), but the necessity of this specific granularity remains unvalidated. This work investigates the impact of predicate representation granular…
items.why_zh: 该研究首次从实证角度检验攻击链生成中谓词建模的粒度选择，有助于优化自动规划系统的知识表示。
items.why_en: This study provides an empirical test of predicate granularity in symbolic attack chain generation, helping to improve knowledge representation in automated planning.

items.title_zh: 基于表情机器人头部的自适应人机交互混合注意力估计流程
items.title_en: Hybrid Attention Estimation Pipeline for Adaptive HRI Using an Expressive Robotic Head
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了基于InMoov生态系统的表情机器人头部的人机交互应用案例，提出一种混合视觉注意力估计流水线。该流程结合快速几何感知层和基于视觉语言模型的语义感知层，其中几何层以高频输出面部和头部姿态信息，用于时间层面上的调节；语义层则直接处理原始第一视角摄像头画面，生成与注意力相关的上下文标签。通过两类信息互补，系统能够更有效地预测人类注意方向，从而支持自适应的人机交互。该工作展示了多模态注意力估计在实体机器人上应用的可行性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00284v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper presents an applied case study on hybrid visual attention estimation for human-robot interaction using an expressive robotic head based on the InMoov ecosystem. The proposed pipeline combines a fast geometric perception layer with an independent semantic perception layer based on a vision-language model. The geometric layer provides high-frequency face and head-pose information for temporal regulation, while the semantic layer receives only raw egocentric camera frames and produces contextual attention labels related to attention tow…
items.why_zh: 该研究展示了结合几何与语义信息的混合注意力估计在实体机器人上的应用，为人机自适应交互提供了新的感知方案。
items.why_en: This work demonstrates a hybrid geometric-semantic attention estimation pipeline on a physical robot head, advancing adaptive human-robot interaction.

items.title_zh: EduPluginBench：面向AI生成教育插件的可执行保障
items.title_en: EduPluginBench: Executable Assurance for AI-Generated Educational Plugins
items.summary_zh: 代码生成模型虽然可以生成可执行组件，但编译和功能测试并不能保证其符合最小权限、遥测同意、来源追溯、特权写入权限、生命周期约束以及失败边界等治理要求。为填补这一空白，研究者提出EduPluginBench，一个面向受治理软件生态中生成插件的可执行基准与分阶段准入方法。在来自30个规范的1,440个经激活检查的一阶变异体上，该方法使P0-P4级别的发布阻断缺陷召回率提升了74.7个百分点。该工作为AI生成代码在受控生态中的安全部署提供了可操作的测试与准入机制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00739v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Code-generation models can produce executable components, but compilation and functional tests do not establish compliance with least privilege, telemetry consent, provenance, privileged-write authority, lifecycle constraints, or bounded failure. We introduce EduPluginBench, an executable benchmark and staged admission method for generated plugins in governed software ecosystems. Across 1,440 activation-checked first-order mutants from 30 specifications, P0-P4 increased release-blocking-defect recall by 74.7 percentage points (specification-clu…
items.why_zh: 该基准为AI生成插件的安全合规审查提供了可执行的测试手段，弥补了传统编译与功能测试在治理约束上的不足。
items.why_en: This benchmark provides executable assurance for AI-generated plugins, addressing compliance gaps beyond compilation and functional tests.

items.title_zh: 大模型为何让步：医疗谄媚背后的对话因素与推理
items.title_en: Why LLMs Give In: Conversational Factors and Reasoning Behind Medical Sycophancy
items.summary_zh: 语言模型在用户质疑时放弃正确的医学答案，比直接给出错误答案更危险，因为这会用正确答案的可信度去强化用户的错误认知。这种“医疗谄媚”行为以往常被归因于模型本身并报告为单一比例，但本研究发现它其实是对话情境的属性，而非模型固有属性。研究者采用四因素全交叉析因设计，系统考察用户角色、虚假断言背后的证据、以及其他对话上下文对模型表现的影响，并剖析模型“屈服”的推理过程。该发现提示，评估大模型的医学可靠性和缓解谄媚行为应从对话层面入手，而非仅调整模型参数。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01017v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A language model that abandons a correct medical answer under user pushback is more dangerous than one that was simply wrong, because it lends the credibility of a correct answer to the user's misinformation. Such model behavior, described as medical sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, but we find it is a property of the conversation, not the model. We study medical sycophancy in language models with a fully crossed factorial design over four conversational factors, user role, the evidence behind a false claim, whether t…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了医疗谄媚是对话属性而非模型固有属性，为安全评估和缓解大模型医疗误导提供了新的视角。
items.why_en: This research reveals that medical sycophancy is a conversational property, not a static model trait, offering new directions for evaluation and mitigation.

items.title_zh: DeVIT：利用差值计算加速低功耗视觉Transformer
items.title_en: DeVIT: Low-Power Vision Transformer Acceleration Using Delta Computation
items.summary_zh: 基于Transformer的视觉模型性能卓越，但高计算复杂度和大内存占用使其难以在资源受限设备上部署。常见的做法是使用低比特权重来降低内存消耗和提升效率。DeVIT方法在此基础上进一步引入差值计算（delta computation），仅针对输入或权重中发生变化的部分执行计算，从而减少冗余操作、降低功耗。该技术为视觉Transformer在边缘端和低功耗场景下的实时推理提供了一种新的加速路径，有望拓展其应用范围。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01343v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The emergence of transformer-based deep learning models has brought unprecedented performance across various domains, particularly in natural language processing and computer vision. However, deploying these models, especially on resource-constrained devices, poses significant challenges due to their high computational complexity and large memory size and bandwidth requirements. This complexity has led researchers to use low-bit model weights to reduce memory usage and improve efficiency. In addition to reducing processing and memory demands, q…
items.why_zh: 该工作为视觉Transformer在资源受限设备上的低功耗推理提供了新的加速方案，对边缘AI应用具有重要意义。
items.why_en: This work presents a low-power acceleration method for vision transformers, which is significant for edge AI deployment.

items.title_zh: 以精确贝叶斯最优标准衡量语言模型的上下文算法推理
items.title_en: Measuring in-context algorithmic reasoning in language models against an exact Bayes-optimal standard
items.summary_zh: 判断大语言模型是真正进行算法推理，还是仅完成模式补全，一直缺乏可靠标准，因为现有基准大多没有给出正确归纳推理的“标准答案”。为此，研究者提出F-ICL基准，利用图灵完备的机器F（经补对称化为sF以消除输出极性偏差），穷举所有长度不超过13的15亿个程序，并在有界通用先验下解析计算贝叶斯最优后验，作为精确参照标准。这一设计让语言模型的上下文学习表现可以与理论最优进行比较，从而更严格地检验其算法推理能力。该基准为理解大模型推理的机制提供了新工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01575v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Whether large language models perform genuine algorithmic reasoning or mere pattern completion is hard to test, because most benchmarks lack a ground truth for correct inductive inference. We introduce F-ICL, an in-context-learning benchmark that supplies one exactly. Using the Turing-complete machine F, complement-symmetrised into sF to remove output-polarity bias, we exhaustively enumerate all 1.5 billion programs of length $L\le13$ and compute the Bayes-optimal posterior in closed form under a bounded universal (Levin--Solomonoff) prior; mod…
items.why_zh: 该基准首次为语言模型的上下文算法推理提供了精确的贝叶斯最优参照，可严格区分真实推理与模式补全。
items.why_en: This benchmark supplies an exact Bayes-optimal ground truth, enabling rigorous separation of genuine algorithmic reasoning from pattern completion in language models.

items.title_zh: 标签定义时间尺度：时间聚合学习的特质-状态极限
items.title_en: The Label Defines the Timescale: Trait-State Limits of Temporal-Aggregate Learning
items.summary_zh: 许多机器学习基准使用的标签是长时间尺度的聚合量，而输入仅来自一个或几个短时间窗口，这导致模型表现的上限可能受到采集协议限制，而非模型容量限制。该研究针对形式为时间平均函数的标签，在潜在高斯过程同时包含稳定的个体特质和相关的个体内状态时，推导出一个精确的协议条件贝叶斯风险恒等式作为统一分析工具。通过该理论框架，研究者分解了特质与状态对学习误差的贡献，揭示了标签时间聚合尺度与数据采集窗口之间的内在矛盾。该工作为机器学习基准设计和模型评估提供了重要的理论指导。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01587v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine-learning benchmarks often pair a label that aggregates a long temporal horizon with input observed through one or a few short windows. Their apparent performance ceiling may therefore be an acquisition-protocol ceiling rather than a model-capacity ceiling. We study labels of the form $\Theta_{g,T}=T^{-1}\int_0^T g\{Z(t)\}\,\mathrm{d}t$ when the latent Gaussian process contains both a stable individual trait and a correlated within-individual state. An exact protocol-conditioned Bayes-risk identity provides a common tool. First, we decom…
items.why_zh: 该研究从理论上指出标签时间尺度与输入窗口的匹配问题，为机器学习基准的合理设计与结果解读提供了依据。
items.why_en: This work reveals that label timescale can impose fundamental limits on temporal-aggregate learning, informing benchmark design and interpretation.

items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型能否评估城市衰败？底特律案例研究
items.title_en: Can Urban Blight Be Accessed with Vision-language Models: A Case Study in Detroit
items.summary_zh: 城市衰败问题在过去15年受到更多关注，评估城市衰败对城市规划和公共健康至关重要。传统的住宅衰败调查因劳动密集、周期长而难以大规模开展。该研究提出一个可扩展框架，利用开源大型视觉语言模型对多视图图像进行结构化提示，评估屋顶等房屋属性，从而估计住宅衰败程度。这种方法有望降低调查成本并提高评估效率，为城市衰败的量化评估提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01753v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Addressing urban blight has seen increased focus in the past 15 years. Assessing urban blight is essential for guiding urban planning, targeting rehabilitation, and safeguarding public health, yet traditional residential blight surveys are difficult to maintain at scale due to the labor-intensive cost and long-term cycle. This study introduced a scalable framework for estimating residential blight using open-source large vision-language models on multiple views. Structured prompts guided models to evaluate housing attributes, including roof int…
items.why_zh: 该研究首次系统探索用开源视觉语言模型大规模评估城市衰败，为城市规划与公共健康提供低成本高效工具。
items.why_en: This work pioneers using open-source VLMs for scalable urban blight assessment, potentially transforming urban planning and public health monitoring.

items.title_zh: 结合专用分割的智能体视觉语言模型用于细粒度车辆损伤评估
items.title_en: Grounding Agentic VLMs with Dedicated Segmentation for Fine-Grained Vehicle Damage Assessment
items.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型在真实视觉评估流程中日益被用作推理代理，但其空间定位能力对细粒度、视觉模糊的目标仍不可靠。在自动车辆损伤评估中，划痕和发丝裂纹等缺陷仅占少量像素且易与反射混淆。研究以Qwen-VL为例，发现先进的VLM在语义分类上表现较强，但需要专用分割模块来提升细粒度定位。该工作为VLM在高精度视觉评估任务中的应用提供了改进方向，对自动驾驶和保险定损等领域具有潜在价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.02470v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as reasoning agents in real-world visual assessment pipelines, yet their spatial grounding remains unreliable for fine-grained, visually ambiguous targets. We study this gap in the context of automated vehicle damage assessment, where fine-grained defects such as scratches and hairline cracks occupy few pixels, produce weak gradient signal, and are easily confused with reflections and surface texture. We show that a state-of-the-art VLM (Qwen-VL) achieves strong semantic classification acc…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了VLM在细粒度视觉评估中的定位短板，并提出结合专用分割的解决方案，对自动驾驶和保险定损等领域意义重大。
items.why_en: It highlights VLM limitations in fine-grained visual tasks and demonstrates the need for dedicated segmentation, which is critical for automated vehicle damage assessment.

items.title_zh: 信任还是检查？理解用户对AI系统信任的动态演化
items.title_en: Trust or Check? Understanding the (Evolutionary) Dynamics of User Trust in AI Systems
items.summary_zh: 随着AI系统能力与采用的增长，用户信任问题日益紧迫。以往研究多侧重AI治理的激励措施，并将用户信任视为一次性采纳决策，忽视了动态演化过程。该研究将信任建模为在重复、不对称交互中用户持续选择减少监控的动态过程，从而更真实地反映信任的形成与变化。该模型有助于理解AI系统与用户之间长期互动中的信任机制，为AI治理提供新视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.24742v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As the capabilities and adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems grow, trust in these AI systems is an increasingly urgent concern. Much research has focused on models of AI governance and has primarily examined incentives for safe development and effective regulation. Hence they typically represented users trust as a one-shot adoption choice rather than as a dynamic, evolving process shaped by repeated interactions. We instead model trust as the dynamic choice of reduced monitoring in a repeated, asymmetric interaction between users…
items.why_zh: 该研究突破性地将用户信任视为动态演化过程而非一次性选择，对AI治理与系统设计具有重要启示。
items.why_en: It reframes trust as a dynamic evolving process, offering a more realistic foundation for AI governance and system design.

items.title_zh: InfoOps Bench：实时信息操作安全基准
items.title_en: InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了一个持续更新的AI安全基准InfoOps Bench，旨在评估前沿语言模型在多大程度上可能被国家支持的信息操作所利用。该基准基于实时监控管道中的2100多个信息操作，覆盖俄罗斯、中国和伊朗国家支持的信息资产。此外，作者发布了一个配套网站，每周更新这些媒体传播的主要主张。由于基准持续动态更新，能够抵抗数据饱和，为评估模型在信息战中的完整性提供了长期工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.28503v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. We draw on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks Russian, Chinese and Iranian state-backed information assets. Alongside this paper, we release a companion website that tracks the most prominent claims spread by state-backed media outlets, updated weekly. The dynamic nature of the benchmark makes it resistant to satu…
items.why_zh: 该基准针对大国信息战动态更新，为防范AI被滥用于信息操作提供了可持续评估工具。
items.why_en: This live benchmark offers a durable way to test frontier models against real-world state-backed influence operations.

items.title_zh: 增强图学习中的公平性：综述
items.title_en: Fairness in Augmented Graph Learning: A Survey
items.summary_zh: 图学习已发展为增强图学习（AGL），融合了联邦学习、图变换器、图压缩等技术。尽管这些方法提升了模型效用，却带来了传统GNN去偏框架难以处理的交叉性公平问题，例如多种敏感属性交织导致的偏见。该论文对这一新兴领域FairGX进行了系统综述，梳理了从传统图学习方法到公平增强方法的发展，并分析了公平性的维护与挑战。这项综述为图学习的公平性研究提供了全面的框架参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2504.21296v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Graph learning has evolved into Augmented Graph Learning (AGL) by integrating specialized machine learning (ML) techniques. Examples include federated learning, graph transformers, and graph condensation. While enhancing model utility, AGL introduces unique intersectional fairness challenges that traditional GNN debiasing frameworks, which primarily focus on message-passing regulations, fail to address. This paper provides a systematic investigation into this emerging field, termed FairGX. We first delineate the shift from conventional…
items.why_zh: 该综述填补了增强图学习公平性研究的空白，为构建公平的图学习系统提供了关键参考。
items.why_en: It provides the first systematic analysis of fairness challenges in augmented graph learning, guiding the design of fairer graph-based AI systems.

items.title_zh: SoK：DARPA AI网络挑战赛（AIxCC）：赛制设计、架构与经验教训
items.title_en: SoK: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC): Competition Design, Architectures, and Lessons Learned
items.summary_zh: 本文首次对DARPA AI网络挑战赛（AIxCC）进行系统性分析。AIxCC是迄今最大规模的全自动网络推理系统竞赛，旨在利用大型语言模型发现并修复真实开源软件中的漏洞。作者基于设计文档、源代码、执行轨迹以及与组织者和参赛团队的讨论，梳理了比赛的结构与关键设计决策。研究表明，AIxCC推动了AI在网络安全自动化中的应用，但也在鲁棒性和实用性方面带来诸多经验教训。该分析为未来类似挑战赛与AI安全研究提供了重要参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.07666v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC, 2023--2025) is the largest competition to date for building fully autonomous cyber reasoning systems (CRSs) that leverage recent advances in AI -- particularly large language models (LLMs) -- to discover and remediate vulnerabilities in real-world open-source software. This paper presents the first systematic analysis of AIxCC. Drawing on design documents, source code, execution traces, and discussions with organizers and competing teams, we examine the competition's structure and key design decisions,…
items.why_zh: 作为AIxCC的首份系统研究，它总结了大模型驱动网络自动化的实践经验，对AI安全领域具有里程碑意义。
items.why_en: It is the first in-depth analysis of AIxCC, offering critical insights into using LLMs for autonomous vulnerability discovery and remediation.

items.title_zh: x预测即所需：通过端点可解码性实现免训练加速生成
items.title_en: x-Prediction Is All You Need:Training-Free Accelerated Generation via Endpoint Decodability
items.summary_zh: 扩散和流匹配模型虽能生成高质量样本，但其ODE采样通常需要数十甚至数百次神经函数评估，计算成本高昂。现有的加速方法往往需要重新训练、蒸馏或重新设计轨迹。该研究探索另一种思路：利用x预测方法，在采样中通过中间状态和路径速度推断端点信息，从而实现免训练的加速生成。该方法无需额外训练成本即可提升采样效率，为扩散模型在实际部署中的高效应用提供了新选择。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.06114v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-quality samples, but their ODE samplers often need tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs). This remains a practical challenge for released checkpoints, since many accelerators require additional design choices and training cost through retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign. We investigate a different route based on $x$-prediction. During sampling, standard affine probability paths already expose $x_0$ information: an intermediate state and its path velocity dete…
items.why_zh: 该研究提供了一种不依赖重新训练的扩散模型加速方案，有望大幅降低生成模型部署成本。
items.why_en: It introduces a training-free acceleration approach that could significantly improve the efficiency of diffusion models in practice.

items.title_zh: 脑电基础模型编码了什么：数据集身份与临床基准的阴性对照套件
items.title_en: What EEG Foundation Models Encode: Dataset Identity and a Negative-Control Suite for Clinical Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: 预训练脑电（EEG）基础模型被广泛用于临床解码，但其跨群体泛化能力及是否经得起阴性对照检验尚不明确。该研究对LaBraM、EEGMamba、CBraMod等七个代表性模型在五个临床任务和四个数据集上进行了系统评估，采用受试者分离的留一法交叉验证或分组五折验证。由于部分数据集缺少患者标识符，作者还进行了记录级评估和患者分离敏感性分析。结果显示，这些模型的表观收益在更强阴性对照下受到挑战。该工作为评估EEG基础模型的临床可靠性提供了严谨的基准方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.24519v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Pretrained EEG foundation models are proposed for clinical decoding, but whether reported gains transfer across populations or survive negative controls is unclear. We benchmark LaBraM, EEGMamba, CBraMod, REVE, LEAD, BENDR, and BIOT on five clinical tasks across four datasets. Primary analyses use frozen linear probes with subject-disjoint LOSO or grouped five-fold validation. Because CAUEEG releases no patient identifiers, it is evaluated at recording level with a patient-disjoint sensitivity. We challenge apparent gains using stronger…
items.why_zh: 该研究通过阴性对照揭示了EEG基础模型泛化能力的隐患，为临床评估设立了更严格的标准。
items.why_en: It establishes a rigorous negative-control methodology that challenges optimistic claims in EEG foundation models, crucial for clinical trust.

items.title_zh: 千字节模型：以种子和量化潜变量表示神经网络
items.title_en: Kilobyte Models: Neural Networks as a Seed and a Quantized Latent
items.summary_zh: 存储和传输训练好的神经网络成本随参数规模增长，成为空中更新、设备端库等带宽受限部署的瓶颈。这篇论文研究一种极端压缩形式：可部署产物不再是权重，而是一段用于重新生成权重的简短“配方”。基于Mapping Networks的思想，将网络权重表达为紧凑可训练潜变量与固定随机基底的函数，因而只需保存潜变量，因为基底和初始化可保持不变或由配方确定。这种方法有望大幅降低模型分发和更新所需的带宽和存储开销，使大型模型的轻量化部署成为可能。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The cost of storing and transmitting a trained neural network scales with its parameter count, a bottleneck for over-the-air updates, on-device libraries, and other bandwidth-bound deployments. We study an extreme form of model compression in which the deployable artifact is not the weights but a short recipe for regenerating them. Building on Mapping Networks, which express a network's weights as a nonlinear function of a compact trainable latent and a fixed random basis, we observe that only the latent need be stored, because the basis and init…
items.why_zh: 该方法可能将神经网络压缩至千字节级，显著降低模型分发与在线更新的成本。
items.why_en: This could shrink neural networks to kilobyte size, cutting distribution and update costs dramatically.

items.title_zh: 可解释机器学习用于交通拥堵预测：揭示不同COVID-19时期的影响
items.title_en: Interpretable Machine Learning for Traffic Congestion Prediction: Unveiling the Impact of Different COVID-19 Periods
items.summary_zh: 交通拥堵预测对缓解拥堵至关重要，但新冠疫情及相应管控措施改变了人们出行行为，增加了预测难度。这项研究以美国加州阿拉米达县为对象，分别预测封锁前、封锁期间和封锁后的拥堵情况。研究中纳入天气、季节性和疫情相关变量，并使用带交叉验证的递归特征消除筛选重要特征、减少过拟合。作者比较了支持向量回归、多元线性回归和递归神经网络等多种模型的表现。结果有助于理解疫情不同阶段对交通流的影响，为特殊时期交通预测与政策制定提供参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Traffic congestion prediction is essential for congestion mitigation, but the COVID-19 pandemic and related control measures altered travel behavior and increased prediction complexity. This study predicts congestion in Alameda County, California, during pre-lockdown, lockdown, and post-lockdown periods. Weather, seasonality, and COVID-19 variables are incorporated, and Recursive Feature Elimination with Cross-Validation is used to select important features and reduce overfitting. Support vector regression, multiple linear regression, recurrent n…
items.why_zh: 揭示了疫情不同阶段对出行行为的影响，有助于在非常规时期提升交通预测和管理的可靠性。
items.why_en: It reveals how different COVID-19 periods affect travel behavior, improving congestion prediction during unusual times.

items.title_zh: SAFE-Merge：无数据持续模型合并，保留通用知识
items.title_en: SAFE-Merge: Data-Free Continual Model Merging with General Knowledge Preservation
items.summary_zh: 无数据持续模型合并需要在无法访问原始任务数据的情况下，将一系列专门模型整合进来，同时保留预训练阶段学到的通用知识和此前学到的任务。现有方法多集中于抑制下游任务之间的干扰，因而保护了已学任务，却容易忽略预训练知识本身的安全，导致模型在分布外数据上的泛化能力下降。为此，论文提出SAFE-Merge，一种简单且不依赖数据的合并方法，旨在合并过程中维护通用知识的完整性。这项工作对构建不断进化的AI系统具有实用价值，有助于避免遗忘与泛化退化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01184v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data-free continual model merging must incorporate a stream of specialized models while retaining both pretrained general knowledge and previously acquired tasks, without access to task data. Existing methods mainly merge task updates by suppressing interference among downstream tasks; while this protects previously acquired tasks, it overlooks the safety of the pretrained knowledge itself, whose erosion degrades generalization to held-out distributions and weakens the foundation for future task acquisition. We propose SAFE-Merge, a simple data-f…
items.why_zh: 该研究弥补了持续模型合并中对预训练知识安全的忽视，保障AI系统持续进化中的泛化能力。
items.why_en: It addresses the overlooked safety of pretrained knowledge, enabling robust and sustainable continual model merging.

items.title_zh: 无处不在的秘密：审计移动预测模型中的记忆化
items.title_en: Secrets Everywhere: Auditing Memorization in Mobility Prediction Models
items.summary_zh: 移动预测模型根据用户历史轨迹预测下一位置，已被广泛应用于城市分析、导航和个性化服务，但它们可能记住并从训练数据中泄露敏感轨迹。与语言模型中的记忆化研究相比，移动预测具有独特挑战：轨迹序列在多个时空尺度上编码人类行为，因此隐私风险也出现在不同粒度上。这篇论文对移动预测模型中的记忆化现象进行了系统审计，旨在揭示这些模型泄露用户位置隐私的范围和方式。该研究对于强化移动数据的隐私保护、设计更安全的位置服务具有重要意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.02052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Human mobility prediction models, which forecast the next location in a user's trajectory, are increasingly deployed in urban analytics, navigation, and personalized services. Yet, little is known about their potential to memorize and expose sensitive user trajectories from training data. While memorization has been extensively studied in language models, mobility prediction poses unique challenges: training sequences encode human behavior at various spatial and temporal scales, creating privacy risks at different granularities. In this paper, we…
items.why_zh: 移动预测模型存在独特的记忆泄露风险，本研究为此类模型的隐私保护提供了关键审计依据。
items.why_en: It audits memorization in mobility models, revealing unique privacy risks and guiding safer deployment.

items.title_zh: 可复现可扩展的竞争风险生存模型基准测试框架
items.title_en: A reproducible and extensible framework for benchmarking competing risks survival models
items.summary_zh: 在竞争风险情境下（如癌症死亡与其他原因死亡互斥），已涌现出大量统计和机器学习方法，但由于缺乏全面、可复现且可扩展的基准框架，这些方法难以被系统评估和采纳。该研究开发了一个开源基准测试框架，支持在多个数据集和评价指标上对竞争风险模型进行标准化比较。该框架强调可复现性和可扩展性，方便研究者加入新方法或新任务。这有望推动竞争风险生存分析领域的模型择优与实践应用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00271v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A wide range of statistical and machine learning methods have been proposed for survival analysis with competing risks, where the occurrence of one event (i.e., cancer death) precludes the occurrence of other events (i.e., cardiovascular disease death). Despite these methodological advances, their systematic evaluation and adoption are limited by the lack of comprehensive, reproducible and extensible benchmarking frameworks. We developed an open-source benchmarking framework for competing risks models that enables their systematic comparison ac…
items.why_zh: 为竞争风险生存分析提供了标准化、可扩展的评测工具，降低方法比较与选择门槛。
items.why_en: It provides a standardized, extensible benchmark, addressing the lack of systematic evaluation for competing risks models.

items.title_zh: 超越车道：基于高分辨率轨迹数据的无序交通流动力学
items.title_en: Beyond Lanes: Traffic Flow Dynamics in Disordered Conditions Based on High-Resolution Trajectory Data
items.summary_zh: 无序交通流通常表现为车道纪律薄弱甚至不存在，车辆异质性强、横向交互持续，传统基于车道的模型难以适用。本研究利用无人机在城市主干道采集的高分辨率轨迹数据，对无序交通的宏观与微观特征进行实证分析。作者将Edie交通流框架推广到二维，用以计算聚合交通变量并构建二维基本图，揭示无序条件下的交通流内在规律。这项工作为弱车道纪律环境下的交通建模和管理提供了新的数据与方法支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00602v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Disordered traffic flow is characterized by weak or non-existent lane discipline in the presence of strong vehicle heterogeneity and continuous lateral interactions, challenging traditional lane-based modeling assumptions. This study presents an empirical study of macroscopic and microscopic aspects of disordered traffic using high-resolution UAV trajectory data collected on an urban arterial. A two-dimensional extension of Edie's framework is applied to quantify aggregate traffic variables and produce a two-dimensional fundamental diagram, rev…
items.why_zh: 该研究填补了无序交通流实证建模的空白，可为无严格车道环境下的交通管理提供依据。
items.why_en: It offers empirical evidence and a modeling approach for disordered traffic, common in many urban areas but rarely studied.

items.title_zh: 物联网网络中无人机联邦学习的部分可观测传输控制
items.title_en: Partially-Observable Transmission Control for UAV-Enabled Federated Learning in IoT Networks
items.summary_zh: 无人机赋能的联邦学习可为大规模物联网提供灵活、按需的边缘智能，但在共享非授权频段中，上行更新传输相互干扰，导致不可靠。该研究开发了一个数据包级传输建模框架，能够刻画缓冲区溢出、时延违约和传输错误，并利用由此得到的数据包投递率（PDR），以分组伯努利掩码方式模拟联邦聚合中的部分更新接收。基于该框架，研究进一步探讨了在部分可观测条件下的传输控制策略，以提升学习性能。这项工作为无人机无线联邦学习在真实物联网环境中的部署提供了关键建模与控制思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00855v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV)-enabled federated learning (FL) can provide flexible, on-demand edge intelligence for large-scale IoT deployments, but operating in shared unlicensed bands makes uplink update delivery interference-coupled and unreliable. In this paper, we develop a packet-level transmission framework that captures buffer overflow, delay violations, and transmission errors, and uses the resulting packet delivery ratio (PDR) to represent partial-update reception through a packetized, Bernoulli-masked FL aggregation process. We then…
items.why_zh: 为无线不可靠环境中的无人机联邦学习提供了传输建模与部分可观测控制的基础，有助于提升物联网边缘智能的可靠性。
items.why_en: It provides a transmission-control framework that makes UAV-based federated learning robust to wireless interference in IoT networks.

items.title_zh: AI模型的语义对齐：概念坍缩、检查点动态与跨语言迁移
items.title_en: Semantic Alignment of AI Models: Concept Collapse, Checkpoint Dynamics, and Cross-Lingual Transfer
items.summary_zh: 语言模型基准测试存在局限：仅看任务结果难以检验模型的概念化能力，而流行的开源基准又容易快速饱和或被纳入训练数据。为更深入理解模型如何关联抽象概念，这项工作引入拓扑方法，对高维嵌入空间进行严格比较。研究围绕概念坍缩、检查点动态和跨语言迁移等主题，分析不同模型或训练阶段之间的语义结构变化。这为评估语言模型提供了一种超越准确率的语义层面指标，有助于提升模型可解释性和鲁棒性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01585v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language model benchmarking is a difficult task. Outcome reasoning alone does not test the model's conceptualization of language and popular open-source benchmarks are quickly saturated or ingested as training data. It is important to test the model's output, but augmenting these tests by characterizing semantic structure gives more insight to how models relate abstract concepts. However, the high dimensional embedding spaces are not easy to interpret. This work demonstrates how topological methods can be used to rigorously compare these spaces…
items.why_zh: 该工作为语言模型提供了基于语义结构的评估新视角，弥补了纯结果评测的不足。
items.why_en: It introduces a topological semantic-alignment approach, enabling deeper evaluation of how AI models organize concepts.

items.title_zh: 运动空间中的生成式布朗桥扩散模型用于增强心肌应变分析
items.title_en: Generative Brownian Bridge Diffusion In Motion Space For Enhanced Myocardial Strain Analysis
items.summary_zh: 心肌应变分析是评估心脏功能的重要手段，但现有技术要么依赖人工调整的后处理且区域准确性不佳，要么需要专用且昂贵的影像采集。本论文提出利用生成模型的强大能力，从常规采集的心脏磁共振（CMR）图像中合成高质量的运动衍生应变值。具体而言，作者在运动空间中开发了一种新颖的布朗桥扩散模型，用于学习应变值的概率分布。该方法有望在避免专用采集和大量人工干预的同时，提升心肌应变分析的准确性与可用性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01677v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Myocardial strain analysis of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) images provides an important tool for evaluating cardiac function. However, current techniques require either human-adjusted post-processing with suboptimal regional accuracy, or specialized and costly imaging acquisitions. In this paper, we propose to leverage the power of generative models to synthesize high-quality motion-derived strain values from routinely acquired CMR sequences. Specifically, we develop a novel Brownian bridge diffusion model in motion space to learn the proba…
items.why_zh: 为心肌应变分析提供了一种无需专用设备和人工后处理的生成式方案，有望推动心脏功能评估的临床普及。
items.why_en: It offers a generative approach for myocardial strain analysis that avoids specialized acquisitions and manual post-processing, potentially widening clinical accessibility.

items.title_zh: 用于联邦边缘学习的学习型数字空中计算
items.title_en: Learned Digital Over-the-Air Computing for Federated Edge Learning
items.summary_zh: 联邦边缘学习通过无线信道的叠加特性实现空中计算聚合，从而将通信与计算融合，避免逐一调度和解码设备。模拟空中计算方案传输未编码更新，但对噪声、衰落和功率失配敏感，而现有的数字空中计算方案结合无源随机接入与压缩感知，在低信噪比环境下表现不佳。本论文提出一种学习型数字空中计算方案，以提升联邦边缘学习在低信噪比条件下的聚合鲁棒性和整体性能。该研究有望增强无线边缘学习中模型更新的可靠传输。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2509.16577v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Over-the-air (OTA) aggregation enables federated edge learning (FEEL) by exploiting the superposition property of the wireless channel to merge communication with computation, eliminating the need to schedule and decode devices individually. Analog OTA schemes transmit uncoded updates but are sensitive to noise, fading, and power misalignment, motivating more robust digital alternatives. However, state-of-the-art (SoTA) digital OTA designs that combine unsourced random access (URA) with compressed sensing struggle in the low signal-to-noise r…
items.why_zh: 通过数据驱动的数字空中计算设计，显著提升联邦边缘学习在复杂无线信道下的可靠性与效率。
items.why_en: It improves the robustness and efficiency of federated edge learning under low-SNR wireless conditions via a learned digital aggregation scheme.

items.title_zh: 胎儿超声中时间与采集偏差的交叉解耦
items.title_en: Intersectional Disentangling of Temporal and Acquisition Bias in Fetal Ultrasound
items.summary_zh: 医疗影像AI的公平性研究常将子群性能差距归因于训练数据中的代表性不足。本研究表明，交叉分析能够解耦由临床因素和采集混杂因素（与目标共变）导致的公平性与性能差距。以产科超声中的扫描时胎儿体重估计为例，作者比较了最先进的深度学习模型与临床金标准Hadlock公式，并利用无监督切片发现发现高误差与其特定模式相关联。该工作凸显了在评估医学AI公平性时，需同时考虑时间和采集相关的偏差来源，而非仅仅归咎于数据代表性问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.02942v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fairness studies of medical imaging AI often explain subgroup performance gaps through under-representation in the training data. We show that intersectional analysis can disentangle fairness and performance gaps arising from clinical and acquisition confounders that co-vary with the target. As a case, we study scan-time fetal weight estimation from obstetric ultrasound, analyzing two models: a state-of-the-art deep learning (DL) model and the clinical gold-standard Hadlock formula. Using unsupervised slice discovery, we find that high-error…
items.why_zh: 为医学影像AI公平性研究提供了新的交叉分析视角，有助于识别并纠正真实世界中的偏差来源。
items.why_en: It provides an intersectional perspective on fairness in medical imaging AI, revealing bias sources beyond mere under-representation.

items.title_zh: HERALD：通过CPU-GPU协作KV缓存检索实现高吞吐量块扩散LLM服务
items.title_en: HERALD: High-Throughput Block Diffusion LLM Serving via CPU-GPU Cooperative KV Cache Retrieval
items.summary_zh: 在长上下文大语言模型（LLM）服务中，KV缓存占用大量GPU内存，挤压批处理容量并导致GPU计算闲置。将缓存卸载到CPU DRAM可恢复容量，但PCIe带宽有限，现有最先进系统只能将其与稀疏注意力结合，仅将一小部分关键缓存取回GPU。然而，这些系统遵循自回归解码的KV访问模式，关键集合在每个token处都会变化，使得选择和提取在每个解码步骤重复，吞吐量受限。HERALD提出一种CPU-GPU协作的KV缓存检索机制，配合块扩散解码，以降低重复提取开销并提高服务吞吐量。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.21633v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The KV cache dominates GPU memory in long-context LLM serving, crowding out batch capacity and leaving GPU compute idle. Offloading the cache to CPU DRAM restores capacity, but the limited PCIe bandwidth forces state-of-the-art offloading systems to pair it with sparse attention, fetching only a small critical subset of the cache to the GPU. These systems, however, follow the KV access pattern of autoregressive decoding, in which the critical set changes at every token: selection and fetching recur at every decoding step, and throughput remai…
items.why_zh: 通过CPU-GPU协作检索与块扩散解码，突破长上下文LLM服务中的内存与PCIe带宽瓶颈，显著提升吞吐量。
items.why_en: It breaks the memory and PCIe bandwidth bottlenecks in long-context LLM serving, enabling higher throughput via cooperative cache retrieval.

items.title_zh: 有限自适应下的上下文石板广义线性模型老虎机
items.title_en: Contextual Slate GLM Bandits with Limited Adaptivity
items.summary_zh: 该研究关注在有限自适应条件下具有广义线性奖励的上下文石板老虎机问题。每一轮，学习器面对N组物品，每个物品由d维特征向量表示，需从每组中选择一个物品组成石板，获得的奖励遵循广义线性模型。作者提出了两种有限自适应设置下的算法：批处理设置下的B-SlateGLinCB和罕见切换设置下的相应变体。这些算法旨在以较少的决策切换次数实现接近最优的累积遗憾，适用于推荐系统等需要减少交互频率的实际场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.31449v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the contextual slate bandit problem with generalized linear rewards under limited adaptivity. At each round, the learner is presented with $N$ sets of items, where each item is represented by a $d$-dimensional feature vector. The learner then constructs a slate by selecting one item per set; the resulting slate yields a scalar reward sampled from a Generalized Linear Model (GLM). We propose algorithms under two limited-adaptivity settings: (a) Batched and (b) Rarely-Switching. For the batched setting, we introduce B-SlateGLinCB…
items.why_zh: 为需要限制策略切换频率的现实推荐场景提供了具有理论保证的板岩选择算法。
items.why_en: It provides theoretically guaranteed slate selection algorithms for settings where decision switching must be limited, such as real-world recommendation systems.

items.title_zh: 基于温度调整后验的稳健贝叶斯优化
items.title_en: Robust Bayesian Optimization via Tempered Posteriors
items.summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化通过迭代拟合高斯过程代理模型并利用采集函数选择新查询点。在局部模型错误设定下，这种反馈循环可能恰好在指导后续决策的区域产生过度自信。本文提出一种温度化的高斯过程贝叶斯优化框架，将似然提升到幂α（0<α≤1）。对于一类由参数g索引的改进式采集函数，包括概率提升（PI, g=0）和期望提升（EI, g=1），该框架能够调整后验以降低错误设定带来的风险。这增强了贝叶斯优化在模型失配场景下的稳健性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.07094v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) iteratively fits a Gaussian process (GP) surrogate to accumulated evaluations and selects new queries via an acquisition function. Under local misspecification, this feedback loop can produce overconfidence precisely in the region guiding subsequent decisions. We develop a tempered GP-based BO framework that raises the likelihood to a power $\alpha\in(0,1]$. For a generalized family of improvement acquisitions indexed by $g$, including probability of improvement (PI, $g=0$) and expected improvement (EI, $g=1$)…
items.why_zh: 提出温度化后验机制，使贝叶斯优化在代理模型错误设定时仍能保持稳健的决策性能。
items.why_en: It enhances Bayesian optimization robustness against model misspecification via tempered posteriors, preventing overconfidence in decision-critical regions.

items.title_zh: 单指标老虎机的最优遗憾界
items.title_en: Optimal Regret for Single Index Bandits
items.summary_zh: 单指标老虎机问题中，奖励依赖于高维上下文的一个未知一维投影以及一个未知奖励函数。该模型将线性老虎机和广义线性老虎机扩展到非参数设置，特别适用于奖励函数事先未知的情况。对于单调奖励函数，已有最优遗憾界，但一般非单调情形仍缺乏充分研究，已知最佳界为Õ(T^{3/4})。本论文针对非单调单指标老虎机提出了最优遗憾界，填补了这一理论空白，为高维上下文决策提供了更强的性能保证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.09454v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the $\textit{single-index bandit}$ problem, where rewards depend on an unknown one-dimensional projection of high-dimensional contexts through an unknown reward function. This model extends linear and generalized linear bandits to a nonparametric setting, and is particularly relevant when the reward function is not known in advance. While optimal regret guarantees are known for monotone reward functions, the general non-monotone case remains poorly understood, with the best known bound being $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{3/4})$ (unde…
items.why_zh: 首次为非单调单指标老虎机建立最优遗憾界，完善了该非参数上下文决策的理论基础。
items.why_en: It establishes the first optimal regret bound for non-monotone single-index bandits, advancing the theory of nonparametric contextual decision-making.

items.title_zh: DRIFT：用于DGA检测的抗漂移不变特征Transformer
items.title_en: DRIFT: Drift-Resilient Invariant-Feature Transformer for DGA Detection
items.summary_zh: 域名生成算法（DGA）不断演化以规避僵尸网络检测，对可靠网络防御构成持续挑战。虽然基于深度学习的检测器在静态条件下表现良好，但面对时间漂移时性能会严重下降。通过一项覆盖2017年至2025年的9年纵向研究，作者实证表明最先进的基于字符和基于词的DGA分类器在新变种出现时迅速失效。为解决该问题，他们提出了一种抗漂移Transformer模型，利用不变特征来保持随时间变化的检测有效性。该研究为DGA检测的长期鲁棒性提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.10436v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Domain Generation Algorithms (DGAs) evolve continuously to evade botnet detection, posing a persistent challenge for dependable network defense. While deep learning-based detectors achieve strong performance under static conditions, they suffer severe degradation when facing temporal drift. Through a 9-year longitudinal study (2017-2025), we empirically show that state-of-the-art character- and word-based DGA classifiers rapidly lose effectiveness as new DGA variants emerge. To address this problem, we propose a drift-resilient Transfor…
items.why_zh: 通过长期实证与不变特征学习，显著提升DGA检测器在概念漂移下的长期鲁棒性。
items.why_en: It tackles temporal drift in DGA detection with invariant-feature learning, improving long-term robustness against evolving botnet evasion.

items.title_zh: 机构：豆包上半年月活超3.8亿，跻身全网APP前16

items.why_zh: 豆包月活跻身全网前16，标志着AI原生应用已从工具升级为国民级应用，印证AI技术的大众化普及。
items.why_en: Doubao's top-16 rank among all apps marks AI-native applications entering the mainstream, proving AI adoption at scale.

items.why_zh: 该榜单直观呈现了国内AI原生应用的用户规模格局，是观察AI赛道竞争态势的重要参考。
items.why_en: The ranking offers a clear view of user adoption among AI-native apps, serving as a key indicator of market competition.

items.why_en: Huawei's theoretical update and major AI products' feature adjustments highlight ongoing shifts in AI technology and product strategy.

items.title_zh: 曝追觅手机负责人俞雷拟离职，上任不足半年
items.title_en: Reports: Dreame Phone Head Yu Lei to Depart After Less Than Six Months
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 4 日消息，据搜狐财经 8 月 3 日援引相关人士消息报道，追觅生态 Eclix 手机掌舵者、前金立集团全球副总裁 俞雷拟从追觅系离职 ，目前其内部飞书账号仍未停用。 报道称，俞雷于 2026 年 3 月正式入职追觅旗下 MOVA， 任手机和 AI 硬件业务负责人 ，据此计算，其加入追觅至今不足半年。 IT之家查询公开资料获悉，俞雷于 2015 年加入金立集团任全球副总裁，向集团董事长直接汇报，分管市场营销和渠道销售业务， 于 2018 年宣布离职 。 此后，俞雷曾担任强脑科技的首席运营官，帮助企业快速完成商业初始化，强脑科技后来也成长为“杭州六小龙”之一。 值得注意的是俞雷还创立过一个智能手机品牌“FreeYond” ，以 DTC 模式主攻海外市场。 界面新闻今年 6 月报道称 ，援引追觅生态品牌 Eclix 负责人俞雷消息称，团队已与国内头部大模型厂商达成深度合作， 预计将于 2026 年 9 月发布第一代 AI 手机 ，双十一前上市。该产品主打高端，定价 5,000 元以上，目前核心团队研发已接近完成，即将进入整机测试阶段。
items.summary_en: According to reports, Yu Lei, head of Dreame's Eclix phone business and former Gionee VP, is planning to leave after less than six months. He joined in March 2026 to lead phone and AI hardware. Earlier reports indicated an AI phone launch in September 2026, so his departure may affect those plans.
items.why_zh: 俞雷的突然离职可能影响追觅AI手机的发布节奏与团队稳定性，反映AI硬件赛道人才流动激烈。
items.why_en: His abrupt departure could disrupt Dreame's AI phone roadmap and team stability, highlighting talent poaching in AI hardware.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash被曝“越狱”，开源大模型的安全边界再受拷问

items.why_en: Security flaws in open-source LLMs threaten AI reliability and trust in open-source approaches.

items.why_en: Doubao's leading MAU highlights its dominance and serves as a benchmark for AI product adoption.

items.title_zh: Real IT Solutions推出AI咨询业务，助力西密歇根企业采用人工智能

items.summary_en: Real IT Solutions Launches AI Advisory Practice to Help West Michigan Businesses Adopt Artificial Intelligence The Herald Palladium
items.why_zh: 该举措反映区域IT服务商正积极布局AI咨询市场，帮助中小企业跨越AI应用的技术与认知门槛。
items.why_en: The move shows IT service providers expanding into AI consulting to help SMBs overcome adoption barriers.

items.title_en: TaoShi Intelligent Raises Over CNY 100M to Supply Apple Chain and Dexterous Hand Firms
items.summary_zh: 作者 | 乔钰杰 编辑 | 袁斯来 硬氪获悉，精密减速器企业陶世智能科技有限公司（以下简称“陶世”）近日完成1.4亿元融资。本轮融资由前海金控，广州国控，海川聚义，杭州众燊参与，德太资本担任财务顾问。融资资金将主要用于产品研发、产线扩建以及机器人领域市场拓展。 陶世成立于2016年，总部位于深圳，主要研发和生产正交90度微型减速器及机器人关节模组。公司核心产品为微型环面包络蜗轮蜗杆减速器，通过将减速与转角功能集成在单一结构中，实现更小体积、更高精度的动力传输。 目前，陶世产品已进入富士康、蓝思科技、先导智能、凌云光等企业供应链，并在人形机器人领域与近百家机器人企业开展合作。其中，公司面向灵巧手推出的关节模组已签署10万台供货协议，客户包括灵心巧手、超维动力、绳肌妙算、中科硅纪等。 随着人形机器人进入产业化阶段，核心零部件供应链正在加速成熟。行业数据显示，人形机器人中执行器系统（电机、减速器、丝杠等）约占整机成本45%，传感器系统约占15%，两者合计超过60%。作为连接动力源与执行端的核心部件，减速器承担着动力传递和精度控制作用，直接影响机器人关节的力量、速度、稳定性和灵活性。目前，减速器也是机器人产业链国产替代的重要环节之一。 与传统谐波、RV、行星减速器不同，陶世选择的是正交传动路线。“传统方案中，要实现90度转向通常需要额外增加转角器，这种方式会带来体积增加、精度损失以及成本提…
items.summary_en: TaoShi Intelligent, a maker of micro reducers and robotic joint modules, has completed a CNY 140 million funding round from investors including Qianhai Financial and Guangzhou Guokong. The funds will support R&D, production expansion, and robotics market development. Its products are used by Apple supply chain giants and it has signed a 100,000-unit supply agreement for dexterous hand joint modules, as reducers become a critical domestic substitution component in humanoid robots.
items.why_zh: 在具身智能产业化浪潮中，核心零部件国产替代与成本控制至关重要，陶世的新融资与订单验证了其技术路线和商业前景。
items.why_en: As humanoid robots move toward industrialization, domestic substitution of core components is key; TaoShi's funding and orders validate its technology and market position.

items.title_zh: 截至今年7月底，国家标准中文版在线阅读量超1.74亿次
items.title_en: National Standards Online Reading Exceeds 174 Million Times by End of July
items.summary_zh: 今天了解到，市场监管总局将免费公开国家标准作为为民办实事的重要举措， 自去年对3万余项国家标准提供免费下载服务后，今年又全文免费公开了2600余项国家标准外文版。截至2026年7月底，国家标准中文版在线阅读量超过1.74亿次、下载量超过5300万次，上线仅三个多月的国家标准外文版在线阅读量超过12万次、下载量超过16万次，《智慧城市时空基础设施 评价指标体系》《有限空间作业安全技术规范》等人工智能与安全方面的国家标准阅读量和下载量位居前列。（央视新闻）
items.summary_en: China's market regulator has been offering free public access to national standards, with online reading of Chinese versions exceeding 174 million times by July 2026. This year, over 2,600 foreign-language versions were also made freely available. AI-related standards like 'Smart City Spatiotemporal Infrastructure Evaluation' are among the most accessed, reflecting growing interest in AI and safety.
items.why_zh: 免费公开国家标准有助于降低企业合规成本，尤其可推动AI领域规范的普及和执行，促进产业健康发展。
items.why_en: Free access to national standards reduces compliance costs and supports the adoption of AI-related norms, fostering healthy industry development.

items.title_zh: 美国政府完成先进 AI 模型自愿性评估框架制定，内容未公开
items.title_en: US Government Completes Voluntary AI Model Evaluation Framework, Details Undisclosed
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 4 日消息，据 Axios 报道，美国政府当地时间周一表示，已经按期完成了一项针对先进 AI 模型评估的自愿性框架制定工作。但白宫并未透露该框架具体包含哪些内容、哪些机构或企业已经查看过，以及企业何时会开始采用这一框架。 IT之家注意到，政策制定者、AI 安全倡导者以及美国盟友都在等待了解，全球最强大 AI 模型将受到怎样的监管规则约束。白宫方面表示：“6 月 2 日行政命令中提出的自愿性框架已经在截止日期前完成。” 一名白宫官员表示：“目前正在与行业讨论下一步计划。”他补充称，政府正在与“远不止 Anthropic、OpenAI 和谷歌”的更多行业合作伙伴展开接触。 在截止日期到来之前，这三家 AI 实验室已经就该框架草案向政府提供了反馈意见。 该框架旨在为 AI 开发商提供一套结构化流程，帮助它们与政府合作，判断正在研发中的模型是否属于监管范围。 据悉，该框架应明确规定，当政府在模型发布前最多提前 30 天获取相关模型时，需要遵守的保密要求、网络安全要求、内部风险管理要求、知识产权保护要求以及禁止披露规定。 此外，框架还应该明确哪些“可信合作伙伴”能够提前获得模型访问权限。 美国总统行政命令明确规定，用于评估 AI 模型高级网络攻击能力的基准测试流程将被列为机密。行政命令所规定的适用模型门槛同样属于机密信息，只会在“适当情况下”向 AI 开发者和研究人员披露。…
items.summary_en: The US government has completed a voluntary evaluation framework for advanced AI models, as required by a June 2 executive order, but details remain undisclosed. The framework aims to establish a structured process for AI developers to determine regulatory scope and includes confidentiality and security requirements when the government accesses models up to 30 days before release. Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google have provided feedback, and the White House is discussing next steps with a broader set of partners.
items.why_zh: 该框架将界定全球最强大AI模型的监管边界，影响行业与政府协作方式。
items.why_en: The framework will shape how the most powerful AI models are regulated and overseen in the US.
